Fine-center phone using wrist view and descend gradually; preserve left-arm continuity and keep right clear.
Retreat from reach limit and tilt fingertips toward phone, then lower carefully rather than extending farther.

Fine-center the watch band at finger-pad height, then close fully; next lift will confirm retention.
Lift fifth object, the watch, with fully closed left gripper and verify retention before carrying it into basket.

After continuity interruption, lower with small retracted increments over basket interior, then release watch fifth and allow settling.
